```{r}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  data <- capture %>%
    mutate(
      sex_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(sex))),
      age_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(age))),
      repro_clean = trimws(as.character(repro_status))
    )

  if (isTRUE(input$adult_only)) {
    data <- data %>%
      filter(
        sex_clean %in% c("f", "female"),
        age_clean %in% c("adult", "ad")
      )
  }

  if (input$site_filter != "All") {
    data <- data %>% filter(site == input$site_filter)
  }

  data
})
```

```{r shiny-app, eval=FALSE}

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)

capture <- read.csv("../Data/capture_cleaned.csv")

capture$date <- as.Date(capture$date)
capture$month <- as.numeric(capture$month)

capture <- capture %>%
  mutate(
    sex = trimws(sex),
    ageclass = trimws(ageclass),
    site = trimws(site),
    site = case_when(
      site %in% c("Lady Evelyn Falls campground", "Lady Evelyn Falls Campground") ~ "Lady Evelyn Falls Campground",
      TRUE ~ site
    ),
    repro_status = trimws(repro_status),
    repro_label = case_when(
      repro_status == "PREG" ~ "Pregnant",
      repro_status == "LAC"  ~ "Lactating",
      repro_status == "POST" ~ "Post-lactating",
      repro_status == "NOP"  ~ "Non-reproductive",
      repro_status == "JUV"  ~ "Juvenile",
      TRUE ~ repro_status
    )
  )

ui <- dashboardPage(
  skin = "blue",
  
  dashboardHeader(title = "🦇 Female Bat Reproductive Timing"),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
  width = 260,
  sidebarMenu(
    id = "tabs",
    menuItem("Reproductive Timing", tabName = "repro", icon = icon("chart-bar"))
  ),
  
  br(),
  
  div(
    style = "padding: 10px;",
    selectInput(
      "site_filter",
      "📍 Select Site",
      choices = c("All", sort(unique(capture$site))),
      selected = "All"
    ),
    hr(),
    p(
      strong("About this app: "),
      "This dashboard shows reproductive timing for adult female bats across months."
    ),
    p(
      strong("Status codes: "),
      "PREG = Pregnant, LAC = Lactating, POST = Post-lactating, NOP = Non-reproductive."
    ),
    hr(),
    p(strong("About site names:")),
    p(
      "Some site names in this dataset are short field codes, such as DT11, NTBP, or SSR-1. These are labels used by researchers to identify different monitoring or capture locations."
    ),
    p(
      "In general, each code refers to a specific sampling site, such as a cave, pond, campground, town area, or another field location where bats were captured or monitored."
    ),
    p(
      "In this app, “site” simply means the location where the bat data were collected."
    )
  )
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    tags$head(
      tags$style(HTML("
        .content-wrapper, .right-side {
          background-color: #f4f6f9;
        }
        .small-box {
          border-radius: 12px;
        }
        .box {
          border-radius: 12px;
          box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
        }
        .main-header .logo {
          font-weight: bold;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      "))
    ),
    
    tabItems(
      tabItem(
        tabName = "repro",
        
        fluidRow(
          valueBoxOutput("total_bats_box", width = 4),
          valueBoxOutput("repro_bats_box", width = 4),
          valueBoxOutput("prop_box", width = 4)
        ),
        
        fluidRow(
          box(
            width = 12,
            status = "info",
            solidHeader = TRUE,
            title = "Current Filter",
            textOutput("filter_msg")
          )
        ),
        
        fluidRow(
          box(
            width = 12,
            status = "primary",
            solidHeader = TRUE,
            title = "📅 Reproductive Status by Month",
            plotOutput("repro_month_plot", height = 400)
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- capture %>%
      filter(sex == "Female", ageclass == "Adult") %>%
      filter(repro_status %in% c("PREG", "LAC", "POST", "NOP"))
    
    if (input$site_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(site == input$site_filter)
    }
    
    df
  })
  
  output$filter_msg <- renderText({
    if (input$site_filter == "All") {
      "Displaying adult female bats from all sites."
    } else {
      paste("Displaying adult female bats from:", input$site_filter)
    }
  })
  
  output$total_bats_box <- renderValueBox({
    total_bats <- nrow(filtered_data())
    
    valueBox(
      value = total_bats,
      subtitle = "Adult Female Bats",
      icon = icon("venus"),
      color = "aqua"
    )
  })
  
  output$repro_bats_box <- renderValueBox({
    reproductive_bats <- filtered_data() %>%
      filter(repro_status %in% c("PREG", "LAC", "POST")) %>%
      nrow()
    
    valueBox(
      value = reproductive_bats,
      subtitle = "Reproductive Females",
      icon = icon("heart"),
      color = "green"
    )
  })
  
  output$prop_box <- renderValueBox({
    total_bats <- nrow(filtered_data())
    reproductive_bats <- filtered_data() %>%
      filter(repro_status %in% c("PREG", "LAC", "POST")) %>%
      nrow()
    
    prop_val <- ifelse(total_bats == 0, 0, reproductive_bats / total_bats)
    
    valueBox(
      value = paste0(round(prop_val * 100, 1), "%"),
      subtitle = "Reproductive Proportion",
      icon = icon("percent"),
      color = "yellow"
    )
  })
  
  output$repro_month_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- filtered_data()
    
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No adult female bat data available for this selection."))
    
    summary_df <- df %>%
      group_by(month, repro_label) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
    
    ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = month, y = count, fill = repro_label)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = sort(unique(summary_df$month)),
        labels = month.abb[sort(unique(summary_df$month))]
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Reproductive Status Across Months",
        x = "Month",
        y = "Number of Adult Female Bats",
        fill = "Reproductive Status"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
